audit_findings.title: Potential gross-asset uplift from non-traded investments
audit_findings.magnitude: $882.6 million of filed contribution liabilities ($126.8 million current plus $755.8 million long-term), equal to $3.52 per share and 2.46% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Omitted obligations would reduce the stakes_net equity-bridge addition.
audit_findings.evidence: The liabilities for estimated future capital contributions are recorded in Other accruals and Other long-term liabilities.
audit_findings.explanation: The bridge's exact composition is unresolved, so gross treatment is not demonstrated. If all filed contribution liabilities were omitted, base value would fall by about $3.52 per share from $142.83, leaving it far below the $332.26 market price. Even removing the entire $999.4 million addition would reduce value by only $3.98 per share.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the $999.4 million line item to the $922.1 million non-traded-investment asset and the $882.6 million associated liabilities; correct the bridge if any liability was omitted.

audit_findings.title: Environmental liabilities may be absent from both OE and the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $264.3 million accrued at June 30, 2026; $338.2 million including the filed $73.9 million unaccrued maximum of reasonably possible estimable outcomes, or $1.35 per share
audit_findings.mechanism: Previously accrued remediation payments can bypass current earnings, requiring either an OE cash charge or an equity-bridge deduction.
audit_findings.evidence: At December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the Company had accruals reported on the Consolidated Balance Sheets as Other long-term liabilities of $ 224.9 million, $ 230.3 million and $ 230.8 million, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The bridge does not show an environmental deduction, while whether forecast OE captures the cash payments remains unresolved. Deducting the entire $338.2 million maximum quantified exposure would reduce base value by about $1.35 per share, less than 1% of base equity value, and would not change the valuation conclusion. Unestimable early-stage or unasserted claims are not included in that amount.
audit_findings.action: Trace environmental provisions and cash payments through the OE calculation; deduct the latest $264.3 million accrual once if those payments are not already captured, and separately monitor unestimable claims.

audit_findings.title: Unaccrued lead-paint litigation is an unmodeled common-equity tail claim
audit_findings.mechanism: A judgment or settlement would reduce equity through a bridge reserve, discrete OE cash charges, or both without double counting.
audit_findings.evidence: We currently have not accrued any amounts for the pending lead pigment and lead-based paint litigation identified below because the Company does not believe it is probable that a loss will occur, or the Company believes it is not possible to estimate the range of potential losses.
audit_findings.explanation: This is an unresolved contingency rather than a demonstrated valuation error: no liability is accrued and the filing says the loss range cannot be estimated. The exposure could reduce value, but the record cannot establish its magnitude or whether it is material to the valuation.
audit_findings.action: Review subsequent case rulings, discovery, trial schedules, settlements, insurance and indemnities; rerun explicit probability-weighted downside scenarios if a supportable exposure range emerges.

audit_findings.title: The 2025 anchor does not contain the disclosed 2026 run-rate interest burden
audit_findings.magnitude: $85.0 million pre-tax, approximately $65.4 million after the filed 23.1% tax rate; 2.66% of anchor OE and approximately $3.66 per share of base value if treated as recurring
audit_findings.mechanism: Because the DCF uses equity-level OE, higher recurring interest expense reduces forecast OE beginning in 2026.
audit_findings.evidence: With the long-term debt maturities refinanced during 2025 and the interest related to the delayed draw term loans to fund the Suvinil acquisition, coupled with the incremental interest expense related to the new global headquarters and research and development center and the higher interest rates used to refinance the long-term debt maturities due in 2026, Interest expense is expected to increase by approximately $85 million in 2026.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated timing mismatch: the forecast grows 2025 OE without the disclosed incremental 2026 interest burden, and first-half 2026 interest expense was already $51.3 million above the prior-year period. A proportional base-case rerun indicates roughly a $3.66-per-share reduction, which does not alter the conclusion against the $332.26 market price.
audit_findings.action: Rerun year one with the full after-tax $85 million increase, reconcile it to 2026 reported interest expense, and normalize subsequent financing costs without deducting debt again.

audit_findings.title: Firetex remediation and claims may represent an unaccrued product obligation
audit_findings.mechanism: Remediation product, labor, damages and legal costs would reduce future OE or require a bridge reserve if already attributable to installed products.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company has received claims regarding this matter, including from a competitor (which culminated in the false advertising claim described below), and is working with its customers and end users to assist in understanding the potential impacts of the listing change, including the extent of potential remedial action that may involve the application of additional product.
audit_findings.explanation: The latest filing confirms received claims and expands the issue to underestimated and excessive software-generated coating specifications, but it provides no affected-volume, cost or accrual amount. The contingency may reduce value, but present evidence cannot establish materiality.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the affected installed base, remediation protocol, cost per installation, claim inventory, insurance coverage and accounting reserve; then rerun OE or the bridge using a probability-weighted net cash exposure.

audit_findings.title: Suvinil creates a partial-year perimeter mismatch
audit_findings.magnitude: Approximately $360.5 million of annual sales absent from the 2025 perimeter ($525.0 million annual sales less $164.5 million included in 2025); OE effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: A full-year operating contribution would increase OE, while full-year interest, maintenance capital, working-capital needs and purchase-accounting effects would reduce it.
audit_findings.evidence: In October 2025, we completed our acquisition of Suvinil, a leading provider of architectural paints in Brazil, with annual sales of approximately $525 million.
audit_findings.explanation: The partial-year mismatch is demonstrated, but sales cannot be converted into owner earnings from the supplied record. The omitted operating contribution and omitted financing and reinvestment costs move value in opposite directions, so materiality and net direction cannot be established.
audit_findings.action: Construct a twelve-month pro forma 2025 OE using Suvinil operating income, cash taxes, maintenance capital, working capital, purchase-accounting items and acquisition financing; then rerun all scenarios from that like-for-like base.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $40.8 million in FY2022, 1.75% of FY2022 OE; computed $0 impact on the current anchor under the MIN(trend, latest) rule
audit_findings.mechanism: Any eligible residual D&A add-back would raise historical OE and potentially the trend calculation, but not the capped latest-year anchor here.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2022 $40.8m (7.0% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: This is conservative classification uncertainty, not an overvaluation error. Even adding all $40.8 million to 2022 OE would leave the trend above the $2,459.2 million latest-year cap, so the anchor and scenario values remain unchanged.
audit_findings.action: Classify the residual only if filed evidence becomes available; no valuation rerun is needed unless the revised trend falls below and therefore replaces the latest-year anchor.
